title: Dissolution of cellulose derivatives in NaOH/urea aqueous solvent and optimisation of a cationic cellulose/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel using response surface methodology
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4518-4534
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07141K, Paper
Open Access

Nur Fattima’ Al-Zahara’ Tuan Mohamood, Norhazlin Zainuddin, Sazlinda Kamaruzzaman, Hidayah Ariffin
A sustainable cellulose hydrogel was developed through Response Surface Methodology optimisation by blending cationic cellulose with carboxymethyl cellulose, followed by epichlorohydrin crosslinking to achieve high gel content and swelling capacity.
